words.gloss: among the gains of army and ally

hindi: दण्ड और मित्र के लाभों में संघ का लाभ सबसे उत्तम है।
english: The gaining of a saṅgha (a confederacy) is the best among the gains of army and ally.
notes: saṅgha: a confederacy / oligarchic corporation; kept as saṅgha (संघ) in both languages.
lines_deva: सङ्घ.लाभो दण्ड.मित्र.लाभानाम् उत्तमः
lines_iast: saṅgha.lābho daṇḍa.mitra.lābhānām uttamaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि संघ संगठित होने के कारण शत्रुओं के लिए अधृष्य होते हैं।
english: For saṅghas, because they are united, are unassailable by enemies.
lines_deva: सङ्घा हि संहतत्वाद् अधृष्याः परेषाम्
lines_iast: saṅghā hi saṃhatatvād adhṛṣyāḥ pareṣām

hindi: उन अनुकूल संघों का साम और दान से उपयोग करे, प्रतिकूल संघों का भेद और दण्ड से।
english: He should make use of those that are favourable by means of conciliation and gifts, and of those that are hostile by means of dissension and force.
notes: daṇḍa here is the fourth upāya (force), not the army.
lines_deva: तान् अनुगुणान् भुञ्जीत साम.दानाभ्याम्, विगुणान् भेद.दण्डाभ्याम्
lines_iast: tān anuguṇān bhuñjīta sāma.dānābhyām, viguṇān bheda.daṇḍābhyām

words.gloss: the Kambojas, Surashtras, kshatriya guilds and others
living by economic activity and arms

hindi: काम्बोज, सुराष्ट्र, क्षत्रिय-श्रेणी आदि संघ वार्त्ता और शस्त्र से जीविका चलाने वाले हैं।
english: The Kambojas, the Surashtras, the kshatriya guilds and others live by economic activity (vārttā) and by arms.
notes: vārttā = agriculture, cattle-rearing and trade. 'kṣatriya-śreṇi' taken as 'guild of kshatriyas'; a dvandva 'kshatriyas and guilds' is also possible.
lines_deva: काम्बोज.सुराष्ट्र.क्षत्रिय.श्रेण्य्.आदयो वार्त्त.शस्त्र.उपजीविनः
lines_iast: kāmboja.surāṣṭra.kṣatriya.śreṇy.ādayo vārtta.śastra.upajīvinaḥ

words.gloss: the Licchivikas, Vrijikas, Mallakas, Madrakas, Kukuras, Kurus, Panchalas and others
living by the title of king

hindi: लिच्छिविक, वृजिक, मल्लक, मद्रक, कुकुर, कुरु, पाञ्चाल आदि संघ राजा की उपाधि से जीविका चलाने वाले हैं।
english: The Licchivikas, the Vrijikas, the Mallakas, the Madrakas, the Kukuras, the Kurus, the Panchalas and others live by the title of king.
lines_deva: लिच्छिविक.वृजिक.मल्लक.मद्रक.कुकुर.कुरु.पाञ्चाल.आदयो राज.शब्द.उपजीविनः
lines_iast: licchivika.vṛjika.mallaka.madraka.kukura.kuru.pāñcāla.ādayo rāja.śabda.upajīvinaḥ

words.gloss: occasions of mutual slight, hatred, enmity and quarrel

hindi: सब संघों के पास नियुक्त गुप्तचर उनके आपसी अपमान, द्वेष, वैर और कलह के अवसरों को जानकर क्रमशः लाया हुआ भेद चलाएँ — 'वह तुम्हारी निन्दा करता है' इस प्रकार।
english: Secret agents stationed near all the saṅghas, having found out the occasions of mutual slight, hatred, enmity and quarrel, should set in motion dissension brought about step by step: 'That one speaks ill of you.'
notes: nyaṅga: slight, insult (lit. a defect).
lines_deva: सर्वेषाम् आसन्नाः सत्त्रिणः सङ्घानां परस्पर.न्यङ्ग.द्वेष.वैर.कलह.स्थानान्य् उपलभ्य क्रम.अभिनीतं भेदम् उपचारयेयुः "असौ त्वा विजल्पति" इति
lines_iast: sarveṣām āsannāḥ sattriṇaḥ saṅghānāṃ paraspara.nyaṅga.dveṣa.vaira.kalaha.sthānāny upalabhya krama.abhinītaṃ bhedam upacārayeyuḥ "asau tvā vijalpati" iti

words.gloss: of those whose anger is fixed on both sides
in matters of learning, crafts, gaming and amusements
agents in the guise of teachers

hindi: इस प्रकार जिनका रोष दोनों ओर बँध गया हो उनके बालकों में आचार्य के वेश वाले गुप्तचर विद्या, शिल्प, द्यूत और विहार के विषयों में कलह उत्पन्न करें।
english: Thus agents in the guise of teachers should stir up quarrels, in matters of learning, crafts, gaming and amusements, among the young of those whose anger has been roused on both sides.
lines_deva: एवम् उभयतो.बद्ध.रोषाणां विद्या.शिल्प.द्यूत.वैहारिकेष्व् आचार्य.व्यञ्जना बाल.कलहान् उत्पादयेयुः
lines_iast: evam ubhayato.baddha.roṣāṇāṃ vidyā.śilpa.dyūta.vaihārikeṣv ācārya.vyañjanā bāla.kalahān utpādayeyuḥ

words.gloss: by praises of the opposite side
of the men of the chiefs of the saṅghas
by winning over the seducible party

hindi: अथवा वेश्यालयों और मदिरालयों में तीक्ष्ण प्रतिपक्ष की प्रशंसा करके संघ-मुख्यों के मनुष्यों में कलह उत्पन्न करें, अथवा कृत्य पक्ष को अपने वश में करके।
english: Or in brothels and taverns, assassins (tīkṣṇas) should stir up quarrels among the men of the chiefs of the saṅghas by praising the opposite side, or by winning over the seducible party.
notes: pratiloma-praśaṃsā: praise directed the wrong way, i.e. praising one man's rival before him. kṛtya-pakṣa: the party that can be won over.
lines_deva: वेश.शौण्डिकेषु वा प्रतिलोम.प्रशंसाभिः सङ्घ.मुख्य.मनुष्याणां तीक्ष्णाः कलहान् उत्पादयेयुः, कृत्य.पक्ष.उपग्रहेण वा
lines_iast: veśa.śauṇḍikeṣu vā pratiloma.praśaṃsābhiḥ saṅgha.mukhya.manuṣyāṇāṃ tīkṣṇāḥ kalahān utpādayeyuḥ, kṛtya.pakṣa.upagraheṇa vā

hindi: हीन भाग पाने वाले कुमारों को श्रेष्ठ भाग के द्वारा उकसाएँ।
english: They should incite the young men who get an inferior share by means of the superior share.
notes: chindikā is a rare word; taken as 'share of food / fare'. The sense is: provoke the young who are fed worse by pointing at those fed better. 'c.ch' in the src is the sandhi doubling of ch after a vowel.
lines_deva: कुमारकान् विशिष्टच्.छिन्दिकया हीनच्.छिन्दिकान् उत्साहयेयुः
lines_iast: kumārakān viśiṣṭac.chindikayā hīnac.chindikān utsāhayeyuḥ

hindi: और श्रेष्ठों के साथ एक पात्र में भोजन या विवाह को हीनों के लिए रोकें।
english: And they should prevent the inferior from sharing a common dish or marriage with the superior.
lines_deva: विशिष्टानां च-एक.पात्रं विवाहं वा हीनेभ्यो वारयेयुः
lines_iast: viśiṣṭānāṃ ca-eka.pātraṃ vivāhaṃ vā hīnebhyo vārayeyuḥ

hindi: अथवा हीनों को श्रेष्ठों के साथ एक पात्र में भोजन या विवाह में जोड़ें।
english: Or they should get the inferior to share a common dish or marriage with the superior.
lines_deva: हीनान् वा विशिष्टैर् एक.पात्रे विवाहे वा योजयेयुः
lines_iast: hīnān vā viśiṣṭair eka.pātre vivāhe vā yojayeyuḥ

words.gloss: on grounds of a reversal of rank

hindi: अथवा हीनों को कुल, पौरुष या स्थान के उलट-फेर के आधार पर समान भाव का दावा करने में लगाएँ।
english: Or they should set the inferior on claiming equal status on grounds of family, of valour, or of a reversal of rank.
notes: No verb in the line; yojayeyuḥ of unit 11 (or utsāhayeyuḥ of 9) is carried over.
lines_deva: अवहीनान् वा तुल्य.भाव.उपगमने कुलतः पौरुषतः स्थान.विपर्यासतो वा
lines_iast: avahīnān vā tulya.bhāva.upagamane kulataḥ pauruṣataḥ sthāna.viparyāsato vā

hindi: अथवा किसी स्थापित व्यवहार को उसके विपरीत व्यवस्था स्थापित करके समाप्त कर दें।
english: Or they should bring an established practice to an end by setting up the reverse of it.
notes: niśāmayeyuḥ: taken from ni-√śam caus. in the sense 'quell, bring to an end'. The commoner sense of niśāmayati is 'make perceived / make known', giving 'make a settled dispute (vyavahāra, lawsuit or transaction) an issue again by setting up the contrary (decision)'. Both fit pratiloma-sthāpana; the translation follows the first.
lines_deva: व्यवहारम् अवस्थितं वा प्रतिलोम.स्थापनेन निशामयेयुः
lines_iast: vyavahāram avasthitaṃ vā pratiloma.sthāpanena niśāmayeyuḥ

words.gloss: by striking at goods, cattle or men

hindi: अथवा विवाद के विषयों में तीक्ष्ण रात में द्रव्य, पशु या मनुष्यों पर आघात करके कलह उत्पन्न करें।
english: Or, in matters under dispute, assassins should stir up quarrels at night by striking at goods, cattle or men.
lines_deva: विवाद.पदेषु वा द्रव्य.पशु.मनुष्य.अभिघातेन रात्रौ तीक्ष्णाः कलहान् उत्पादयेयुः
lines_iast: vivāda.padeṣu vā dravya.paśu.manuṣya.abhighātena rātrau tīkṣṇāḥ kalahān utpādayeyuḥ

words.gloss: in the destruction of the opposing party

hindi: और सब कलह के अवसरों पर राजा हीन पक्ष को कोश और दण्ड से सहारा देकर प्रतिपक्ष के वध में लगाए।
english: And on all occasions of quarrel the king, having supported the weaker party with treasury and army, should set it to the destruction of the opposing party.
lines_deva: सर्वेषु च कलह.स्थानेषु हीन.पक्षं राजा कोश.दण्डाभ्याम् उपगृह्य प्रतिपक्ष.वधे योजयेत्
lines_iast: sarveṣu ca kalaha.sthāneṣu hīna.pakṣaṃ rājā kośa.daṇḍābhyām upagṛhya pratipakṣa.vadhe yojayet

hindi: अथवा फूटकर अलग हुए लोगों को हटा ले जाए।
english: Or he should remove elsewhere those who have been split off.
lines_deva: भिन्नान् अपवाहयेद् वा
lines_iast: bhinnān apavāhayed vā

hindi: और इनको पाँच-पाँच या दस-दस कुलों के समूह में खेती योग्य भूमि पर बसाए।
english: And he should settle them on cultivable land in groups of five or ten families.
lines_deva: भूमौ च-एषां पञ्च.कुलीं दश.कुलीं वा कृष्यायां निवेशयेत्
lines_iast: bhūmau ca-eṣāṃ pañca.kulīṃ daśa.kulīṃ vā kṛṣyāyāṃ niveśayet

hindi: क्योंकि एक स्थान पर रहने से वे शस्त्र उठाने में समर्थ हो सकते हैं।
english: For, staying in one place, they might become capable of taking up arms.
lines_deva: एकस्था हि शस्त्र.ग्रहण.समर्थाः स्युः
lines_iast: ekasthā hi śastra.grahaṇa.samarthāḥ syuḥ

hindi: और इनके एकत्र होने पर दण्ड निर्धारित करे।
english: And he should lay down a penalty for their assembling together.
notes: atyaya = fine/penalty; Hindi दण्ड here means penalty, not the army.
lines_deva: समवाये च-एषाम् अत्ययं स्थापयेत्
lines_iast: samavāye ca-eṣām atyayaṃ sthāpayet

words.gloss: by those bearing the title of king
in the status of a prince

hindi: राजा की उपाधि धारण करने वालों के द्वारा रोके गए या अपमानित किए गए कुलीन और अभिजात व्यक्ति को राजपुत्र के पद पर स्थापित करे।
english: He should install in the status of a prince one of good family and noble birth who has been kept out or cast down by those bearing the title of king.
lines_deva: राज.शब्दिभिर् अवरुद्धम् अवक्षिप्तं वा कुल्यम् अभिजातं राज.पुत्रत्वे स्थापयेत्
lines_iast: rāja.śabdibhir avaruddham avakṣiptaṃ vā kulyam abhijātaṃ rāja.putratve sthāpayet

words.gloss: possession of the marks of a king

hindi: और उसका कार्तान्तिक आदि वर्ग संघों में उसके राज-लक्षणों से युक्त होने को प्रकट करे।
english: And his group, the soothsayer and others, should proclaim in the saṅghas his possession of the marks of a king.
notes: kārtāntika: soothsayer, reader of fate (kṛtānta); distinct from mauhūrtika, the astrologer of 10.1.
lines_deva: कार्तान्तिक.आदिश् च-अस्य वर्गो राज.लक्षण्यतां सङ्घेषु प्रकाशयेत्
lines_iast: kārtāntika.ādiś ca-asya vargo rāja.lakṣaṇyatāṃ saṅgheṣu prakāśayet

hindi: और संघों के धर्मिष्ठ मुख्यों को गुप्त रूप से उकसाए — 'उस राजा के पुत्र या भाई के प्रति अपने धर्म का पालन करो'।
english: And he should secretly instigate the most righteous chiefs of the saṅghas: 'Fulfil your own dharma towards the son or the brother of that king.'
lines_deva: सङ्घ.मुख्यांश् च धर्मिष्ठा-न् उपजपेत् "स्व.धर्मम् अमुष्य राज्ञः पुत्रे भ्रातरि वा प्रतिपद्यध्वम्" इति
lines_iast: saṅgha.mukhyāṃś ca dharmiṣṭhā-n upajapet "sva.dharmam amuṣya rājñaḥ putre bhrātari vā pratipadyadhvam" iti

words.gloss: for winning over the seducible party

hindi: उनके स्वीकार कर लेने पर कृत्य पक्ष को वश में करने के लिए धन और दण्ड भेजे।
english: When they have agreed, he should send money and an army for the purpose of winning over the seducible party.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नेषु कृत्य.पक्ष.उपग्रह.अर्थम् अर्थं दण्डं च प्रेषयेत्
lines_iast: pratipanneṣu kṛtya.pakṣa.upagraha.artham arthaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca preṣayet

words.gloss: at the time of the attack
agents in the guise of liquor-sellers
on the pretext of the death of a son or wife

hindi: आक्रमण के समय शौण्डिक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर पुत्र या स्त्री की मृत्यु के बहाने 'यह नैषेचनिक है' कहकर मदन-रस मिले हुए सैकड़ों मद्य के घड़े दें।
english: At the time of the attack, agents in the guise of liquor-sellers, on the pretext of the death of a son or wife, saying 'this is the funeral offering', should give out by hundreds jars of liquor mixed with madana juice.
notes: naiṣecanika: an offering (of drink) connected with funeral rites. madana-rasa: juice of the madana plant, a stupefying drug; name kept.
lines_deva: विक्रम.काले शौण्डिक.व्यञ्जनाः पुत्र.दार.प्रेत.अपदेशेन "नैषेचनिकम्" इति मदन.रस.युक्तान् मद्य.कुम्भान्-शतशः प्रयच्छेयुः
lines_iast: vikrama.kāle śauṇḍika.vyañjanāḥ putra.dāra.preta.apadeśena "naiṣecanikam" iti madana.rasa.yuktān madya.kumbhān-śataśaḥ prayaccheyuḥ

words.gloss: at sanctuaries, shrines, gates and guard-posts
a deposit relating to an act of covenant
tokens and seals together with gold

hindi: और चैत्य, देवालय, द्वार और रक्षा-स्थानों में गुप्तचर समय-कर्म की धरोहर, सोने सहित पहचान-चिह्न और मुद्राएँ तथा सोने के पात्र दिखाएँ।
english: And at sanctuaries, shrines, gates and guard-posts, secret agents should point out a deposit relating to an act of covenant, tokens and seals together with gold, and vessels of gold.
notes: samaya-karma-nikṣepa: a deposit made as if under a secret agreement (planted to incriminate the chiefs).
lines_deva: चैत्य.दैवत.द्वार.रक्षा.स्थानेषु च सत्त्रिणः समय.कर्म.निक्षेपं सहिरण्य.अभिज्ञान.मुद्राणि हिरण्य.भाजनानि च प्ररूपयेयुः
lines_iast: caitya.daivata.dvāra.rakṣā.sthāneṣu ca sattriṇaḥ samaya.karma.nikṣepaṃ sahiraṇya.abhijñāna.mudrāṇi hiraṇya.bhājanāni ca prarūpayeyuḥ

words.gram: m. loc. pl. (loc. abs. with saṅgheṣu), pres. pass. part. √dṛś

hindi: और संघों के देखे जाने पर 'ये राजा के लोग हैं' ऐसा सूचित करें।
english: And when the saṅghas are seen (there), they should report: 'They are the king's men.'
notes: dṛśyamāneṣu saṅgheṣu taken together (both loc. pl.): when members of the saṅghas are seen at the places where the deposits, tokens and gold vessels of unit 25 were planted, the agents report them as men in the king's pay. Alternative (less likely, breaks the agreement): dṛśyamāneṣu with the planted objects, 'when these are seen'. rājakīyāḥ: 'in the king's pay'.
lines_deva: दृश्यमानेषु च सङ्घेषु "राजकीयाः" इत्य् आवेदयेयुः
lines_iast: dṛśyamāneṣu ca saṅgheṣu "rājakīyāḥ" ity āvedayeyuḥ

hindi: तब आक्रमण करे।
english: Then he should make an assault.
lines_deva: अथ-अवस्कन्दं दद्यात्
lines_iast: atha-avaskandaṃ dadyāt

words.gloss: to the chief of the saṅgha

hindi: अथवा संघों से वाहन और सोना कुछ समय के लिए उधार लेकर संघ-मुख्य को प्रसिद्ध द्रव्य दे।
english: Or, having taken on loan for a time conveyances and gold from the saṅghas, he should give the chief of the saṅgha well-known goods.
notes: prakhyātam dravyam: goods that are well known (so that the gift can be identified), i.e. the borrowed items themselves.
lines_deva: सङ्घानां वा वाहन.हिरण्ये कालिके गृहीत्वा सङ्घ.मुख्याय प्रख्यातं द्रव्यं प्रयच्छेत्
lines_iast: saṅghānāṃ vā vāhana.hiraṇye kālike gṛhītvā saṅgha.mukhyāya prakhyātaṃ dravyaṃ prayacchet

hindi: जब वे उसे वापस माँगें तो कहे — 'वह उस मुख्य को दे दिया गया है'।
english: When these ask for it back, he should say: 'It has been given to that chief.'
lines_deva: तद् एषां याचिते "दत्तम् अमुष्मै मुख्याय" इति ब्रूयात्
lines_iast: tad eṣāṃ yācite "dattam amuṣmai mukhyāya" iti brūyāt

words.gloss: sowing dissension in a military camp and among forest tribes

hindi: इससे सेना-शिविर और आटविकों में भेद डालना समझा दिया गया।
english: By this is explained the sowing of dissension in a military camp and among forest tribes.
lines_deva: एतेन स्कन्ध.आवार.अटवी.भेदो व्याख्यातः
lines_iast: etena skandha.āvāra.aṭavī.bhedo vyākhyātaḥ

words.gloss: the son of a chief of a saṅgha

hindi: अथवा गुप्तचर अपने को बड़ा समझने वाले किसी संघ-मुख्य के पुत्र को यह विश्वास दिलाए — 'तुम उस राजा के पुत्र हो, शत्रु के भय से यहाँ रखे गए हो'।
english: Or a secret agent should make the son of a chief of a saṅgha, who thinks highly of himself, believe: 'You are the son of that king; from fear of enemies you have been placed here.'
lines_deva: सङ्घ.मुख्य.पुत्रम् आत्म.सम्भावितं वा सत्त्री ग्राहयेत् "अमुष्य राज्ञः पुत्रस् त्वम्, शत्रु.भयाद् इह न्यस्तो ऽसि" इति
lines_iast: saṅgha.mukhya.putram ātma.sambhāvitaṃ vā sattrī grāhayet "amuṣya rājñaḥ putras tvam, śatru.bhayād iha nyasto 'si" iti

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने वाले उस व्यक्ति को राजा कोश और दण्ड से सहारा देकर संघों पर आक्रमण कराए।
english: The king, having supported with treasury and army the one who has accepted this, should make him attack the saṅghas.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं राजा कोश.दण्डाभ्याम् उपगृह्य सङ्घेषु विक्रमयेत्
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ rājā kośa.daṇḍābhyām upagṛhya saṅgheṣu vikramayet

hindi: प्रयोजन सिद्ध हो जाने पर उसे भी मार डाले।
english: Having attained his object, he should do away with him too.
notes: pravāsayet: literally 'send away'; in this text usually a euphemism for putting to death, which the context (units 47-48) supports; 'banish' is the alternative.
lines_deva: अवाप्त.अर्थस् तम् अपि प्रवासयेत्
lines_iast: avāpta.arthas tam api pravāsayet

hindi: गुप्तचर के रूप में भेजे गए बन्धकी-पोषक अथवा प्लवक, नट, नर्तक और सौभिक परम रूप और यौवन वाली स्त्रियों से संघ-मुख्यों को उन्मत्त कर दें।
english: Keepers of harlots, or acrobats, actors, dancers and showmen, sent out as agents, should infatuate the chiefs of the saṅghas with women of supreme beauty and youth.
notes: saubhika: a showman / conjurer (exact profession uncertain).
lines_deva: बन्धकी.पोषकाः प्लवक.नट.नर्तक.सौभिका वा प्रणिहिताः स्त्रीभिः परम.रूप.यौवनाभिः सङ्घ.मुख्यान् उन्मादयेयुः
lines_iast: bandhakī.poṣakāḥ plavaka.naṭa.nartaka.saubhikā vā praṇihitāḥ strībhiḥ parama.rūpa.yauvanābhiḥ saṅgha.mukhyān unmādayeyuḥ

words.gloss: of those in whom desire has arisen

hindi: जिनमें काम उत्पन्न हो गया हो उनमें से किसी एक को विश्वास दिलाकर, अन्यत्र चले जाने या बलपूर्वक हरण के द्वारा कलह उत्पन्न करें।
english: Having created confidence in one of those in whom desire has arisen, they should stir up quarrels by (her) going elsewhere or by forcible abduction.
notes: '(her)' is supplied: the Sanskrit has only 'going elsewhere' (the woman leaving the man she has encouraged).
lines_deva: जात.कामानाम् अन्यतमस्य प्रत्ययं कृत्वा-अन्यत्र गमनेन प्रसभ.हरणेन वा कलहान् उत्पादयेयुः
lines_iast: jāta.kāmānām anyatamasya pratyayaṃ kṛtvā-anyatra gamanena prasabha.haraṇena vā kalahān utpādayeyuḥ

hindi: कलह में तीक्ष्ण अपना काम कर दें — 'यह कामुक इस प्रकार मारा गया' इस प्रकार।
english: In the quarrel the assassins should do the deed, so that it is said: 'This lover has been killed thus.'
notes: karma: the killing; the quoted words are the story to be spread.
lines_deva: कलहे तीक्ष्णाः कर्म कुर्युः "हतो ऽयम् इत्थं कामुकः" इति
lines_iast: kalahe tīkṣṇāḥ karma kuryuḥ "hato 'yam itthaṃ kāmukaḥ" iti

words.gram: m. acc. sg., ppp. caus. vi-sam-√vad
m. acc. sg., pres. part. caus. √mṛṣ
m. loc. sg., pres. part. √jīv (loc. abs.)

hindi: अथवा जो धोखा खाकर भी सह रहा हो उसके पास जाकर स्त्री कहे — 'वह मुख्य मुझे, जो तुम पर आसक्त हूँ, सताता है; उसके जीवित रहते मैं यहाँ नहीं रहूँगी' — इस प्रकार उसके वध का प्रयोग कराए।
english: Or, approaching one who has been cheated and yet bears it patiently, the woman should say: 'That chief harasses me, who am in love with you; while he lives I will not stay here' — and so she should bring about his killing.
lines_deva: विसंवादितं वा मर्षयमाणम् अभिसृत्य स्त्री ब्रूयात् "असौ मां मुख्यस् त्वयि जात.कामां बाधते, तस्मिन्-जीवति न-इह स्थास्यामि" इति घातम् अस्य प्रयोजयेत्
lines_iast: visaṃvāditaṃ vā marṣayamāṇam abhisṛtya strī brūyāt "asau māṃ mukhyas tvayi jāta.kāmāṃ bādhate, tasmin-jīvati na-iha sthāsyāmi" iti ghātam asya prayojayet

words.gloss: at the edge of a forest

hindi: अथवा बलपूर्वक हर ली गई वह स्त्री वन के किनारे या क्रीड़ा-गृह में रात में हरण करने वाले को तीक्ष्ण से मरवा दे, अथवा स्वयं विष से।
english: Or, when carried off by force, she should have the abductor killed by an assassin at night at the edge of a forest or in a pleasure-house, or (do so) herself with poison.

text_flags.why: krīḍā (play) has a long ī; 'kriḍā' is a possible typing slip.

lines_deva: प्रसह्य.अपहृता वा वन.अन्ते क्रिडा.गृहे वा-अपहर्तारं रात्रौ तीक्ष्णेन घातयेत्, स्वयं वा रसेन
lines_iast: prasahya.apahṛtā vā vana.ante kriḍā.gṛhe vā-apahartāraṃ rātrau tīkṣṇena ghātayet, svayaṃ vā rasena

hindi: फिर प्रकट करे — 'मेरा प्रिय उसके द्वारा मारा गया'।
english: Then she should proclaim: 'My beloved has been killed by that man.'
lines_deva: ततः प्रकाशयेत् "अमुना मे प्रियो हतः" इति
lines_iast: tataḥ prakāśayet "amunā me priyo hataḥ" iti

words.gloss: one in whom desire has arisen
an agent in the guise of a holy man

hindi: अथवा सिद्ध के वेश वाला गुप्तचर कामासक्त व्यक्ति का वशीकरण की औषधियों से संवास कराकर विष से छल करके चला जाए।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a holy man (siddha), having brought one in whom desire has arisen to cohabit by means of love-winning herbs, should overreach him with poison and go away.
notes: sāṃvadanikī: 'producing agreement / affection', i.e. a love-charm. saṃvāsya: making him live with the woman.
lines_deva: जात.कामं वा सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनः सांवदनिकीभिर् औषधीभिः संवास्य रसेन-अतिसन्धाय-अपगच्छेत्
lines_iast: jāta.kāmaṃ vā siddha.vyañjanaḥ sāṃvadanikībhir auṣadhībhiḥ saṃvāsya rasena-atisandhāya-apagacchet

words.gram: m. loc. sg., ppp. apa-√kram (loc. abs.)

hindi: उसके चले जाने पर गुप्तचर यह आरोप लगाएँ कि यह शत्रु का प्रयोग था।
english: When he has gone away, secret agents should allege that it was the doing of an enemy.
lines_deva: तस्मिन्न् अपक्रान्ते सत्त्रिणः पर.प्रयोगम् अभिशंसेयुः
lines_iast: tasminn apakrānte sattriṇaḥ para.prayogam abhiśaṃseyuḥ

words.gloss: for the sake of inheritance or a deposit

words.gram: f. nom. pl., pres. part. ātm. vi-√vad

hindi: योग-स्त्रियाँ, गुप्त आजीविका वाली धनी विधवाएँ, दाय या धरोहर के लिए विवाद करती हुई संघ-मुख्यों को उन्मत्त कर दें, अथवा अदिति-कौशिक स्त्रियाँ या नर्तकियाँ और गायिकाएँ।
english: Women agents, rich widows with a secret livelihood, disputing over an inheritance or a deposit, should infatuate the chiefs of the saṅghas; or women of the Aditi-Kausika (class), or dancing-girls and singers.
notes: āḍhya-vidhavāḥ gūḍha-ājīvāḥ yoga-striyaḥ taken as one group: women agents in the role of rich widows with a hidden source of income; the two vā mark the alternative groups (agents / Aditi-Kauśika women / dancers and singers). aditi-kauśika: a class of women named after Aditi and Kauśika (mendicants or show-people?); sense uncertain, kept as a name. yoga-strī: a woman employed as a secret agent.
lines_deva: आढ्य.विधवा गूढ.आजीवा योग.स्त्रियो वा दाय.निक्षेप.अर्थं विवदमानाः सङ्घ.मुख्यान् उन्मादयेयुः, अदिति.कौशिक.स्त्रियो नर्तकी.गायना वा
lines_iast: āḍhya.vidhavā gūḍha.ājīvā yoga.striyo vā dāya.nikṣepa.arthaṃ vivadamānāḥ saṅgha.mukhyān unmādayeyuḥ, aditi.kauśika.striyo nartakī.gāyanā vā

hindi: जो मान गए हों और रात के मिलन के लिए गुप्त घरों में प्रविष्ट हुए हों, उन्हें तीक्ष्ण मार डालें अथवा बाँधकर ले जाएँ।
english: Those who have responded and entered secret houses for a nocturnal rendezvous, assassins should kill, or bind and carry off.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नान् गूढ.वेश्मसु रात्रि.समागम.प्रविष्टांस् तीक्ष्णा हन्युर् बद्ध्वा हरेयुर् वा
lines_iast: pratipannān gūḍha.veśmasu rātri.samāgama.praviṣṭāṃs tīkṣṇā hanyur baddhvā hareyur vā

hindi: अथवा गुप्तचर स्त्री-लोलुप संघ-मुख्य को बताए — 'उस गाँव में एक दरिद्र कुल अलग जा बसा है; उसकी स्त्री राजा के योग्य है; उसे ले लो'।
english: Or a secret agent should tell a chief of a saṅgha who is greedy for women: 'In that village a poor family has withdrawn; the woman of that family is worthy of a king; take her.'

text_flags.why: possible: kula (family) has a single l; 'kullam' is not a known word and 'daridra-kulam apasṛtam' gives the required sense.

notes: apasṛtam: 'gone away, living apart'; the family has moved away to that village.
lines_deva: सत्त्री वा स्त्री.लोलुपं सङ्घ.मुख्यं प्ररूपयेत् "अमुष्मिन् ग्रामे दरिद्र.कुल्लम् अपसृतम्, तस्य स्त्री राज.अर्हा, गृहाण-एनाम्" इति
lines_iast: sattrī vā strī.lolupaṃ saṅgha.mukhyaṃ prarūpayet "amuṣmin grāme daridra.kullam apasṛtam, tasya strī rāja.arhā, gṛhāṇa-enām" iti

words.gloss: the agent in the guise of a holy man
in the midst of the treasonable chiefs of the saṅgha

hindi: उसके ले लिए जाने पर आधे महीने के बाद सिद्ध के वेश वाला गुप्तचर दूष्य संघ-मुख्यों के बीच चिल्लाए — 'वह मुख्य मेरी भार्या, पुत्रवधू, बहन या पुत्री के साथ व्यभिचार कर रहा है'।
english: When she has been taken, after half a month the agent in the guise of a holy man should cry out in the midst of the treasonable chiefs of the saṅgha: 'That chief is violating my wife, or daughter-in-law, or sister, or daughter.'
lines_deva: गृहीतायाम् अर्ध.मास.अनन्तरं सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनो दूष्य.सङ्घ.मुख्य.मध्ये प्रक्रोशेत् "असौ मे मुख्यो भार्यां स्नुषां भगिनीं दुहितरं वा-अधिचरति" इति
lines_iast: gṛhītāyām ardha.māsa.anantaraṃ siddha.vyañjano dūṣya.saṅgha.mukhya.madhye prakrośet "asau me mukhyo bhāryāṃ snuṣāṃ bhaginīṃ duhitaraṃ vā-adhicarati" iti

hindi: यदि संघ उसे दण्डित करे तो राजा उसे अपने पक्ष में लेकर प्रतिकूल लोगों पर आक्रमण कराए।
english: If the saṅgha punishes him, the king, having taken him under his protection, should make him attack the hostile ones.
lines_deva: तं चेत् सङ्घो निगृह्णीयात्, राजा-एनम् उपगृह्य विगुणेषु विक्रमयेत्
lines_iast: taṃ cet saṅgho nigṛhṇīyāt, rājā-enam upagṛhya viguṇeṣu vikramayet

words.gloss: the agent in the guise of a holy man

hindi: यदि वह दण्डित न किया जाए तो तीक्ष्ण रात में सिद्ध के वेश वाले गुप्तचर को मार डालें।
english: If he is not punished, assassins should do away with the agent in the guise of a holy man at night.
notes: pravāsayeyuḥ: put to death (see unit 33); unit 48 confirms a killing.
lines_deva: अनिगृहीते सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनं रात्रौ तीक्ष्णाः प्रवासयेयुः
lines_iast: anigṛhīte siddha.vyañjanaṃ rātrau tīkṣṇāḥ pravāsayeyuḥ

hindi: तब उसी वेश वाले गुप्तचर चिल्लाएँ — 'वह ब्रह्महत्यारा और ब्राह्मणी का जार है'।
english: Then agents in that same guise should cry out: 'That man is a slayer of a brahman and the paramour of a brahman's wife.'
lines_deva: ततस् तद्.व्यञ्जनाः प्रक्रोशेयुः "असौ ब्रह्महा ब्राह्मणी.जारश् च" इति
lines_iast: tatas tad.vyañjanāḥ prakrośeyuḥ "asau brahmahā brāhmaṇī.jāraś ca" iti

words.gloss: an agent in the guise of a soothsayer

hindi: अथवा कार्तान्तिक के वेश वाला गुप्तचर एक व्यक्ति द्वारा वरण की गई कन्या का दूसरे के सामने वर्णन करे — 'उसकी कन्या राजपत्नी और राजा की माता होगी; अपना सर्वस्व देकर या बलपूर्वक उसे प्राप्त करो'।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a soothsayer should describe to one man a maiden betrothed to another: 'The daughter of that man will become a king's wife and the mother of a king; obtain her with all your property or by force.'
lines_deva: कार्तान्तिक.व्यञ्जनो वा कन्याम् अन्येन वृताम् अन्यस्य प्ररूपयेत् "अमुष्य कन्या राज.पत्नी राज.प्रसविनी च भविष्यति, सर्व.स्वेन प्रसह्य वा-एनां लभस्व" इति
lines_iast: kārtāntika.vyañjano vā kanyām anyena vṛtām anyasya prarūpayet "amuṣya kanyā rāja.patnī rāja.prasavinī ca bhaviṣyati, sarva.svena prasahya vā-enāṃ labhasva" iti

words.gram: f. loc. sg., pres. pass. part. √labh (loc. abs.)

hindi: यदि वह प्राप्त न हो तो दूसरे पक्ष को उकसाए।
english: If she is not obtained, he should incite the other party.
lines_deva: अलभ्यमानायां पर.पक्षम् उद्धर्षयेत्
lines_iast: alabhyamānāyāṃ para.pakṣam uddharṣayet

hindi: यदि वह प्राप्त हो जाए तो कलह सिद्ध हो गया।
english: If she is obtained, the quarrel is accomplished.
lines_deva: लब्धायां सिद्धः कलहः
lines_iast: labdhāyāṃ siddhaḥ kalahaḥ

hindi: अथवा भिक्षुकी अपनी भार्या से प्रेम करने वाले मुख्य से कहे — 'उस मुख्य ने यौवन के मद में मुझे तुम्हारी भार्या के पास भेजा; उसके भय से मैं पत्र और आभूषण लेकर आई हूँ; तुम्हारी भार्या निर्दोष है; इसका गुप्त रूप से प्रतिकार करना चाहिए; मैं भी अपनी ओर से वैसा ही करूँगी'।
english: Or a female mendicant should say to a chief who is fond of his wife: 'That chief, puffed up with youth, sent me to your wife; out of fear of him I have come, bringing the letter and the ornament; your wife is blameless; revenge must be taken on him secretly; I too, for my part, will act accordingly.'
lines_deva: भिक्षुकी वा प्रिय.भार्यं मुख्यं ब्रूयात् "असौ ते मुख्यो यौवन.उत्सिक्तो भार्यायां मां प्राहिणोत्, तस्य-अहं भयाल् लेख्यम् आभरणं गृहीत्वा-आगता-अस्मि, निर्दोषा ते भार्या, गूढम् अस्मिन् प्रतिकर्तव्यम्, अहम् अपि तावत् प्रतिपत्स्यामि" इति
lines_iast: bhikṣukī vā priya.bhāryaṃ mukhyaṃ brūyāt "asau te mukhyo yauvana.utsikto bhāryāyāṃ māṃ prāhiṇot, tasya-ahaṃ bhayāl lekhyam ābharaṇaṃ gṛhītvā-āgatā-asmi, nirdoṣā te bhāryā, gūḍham asmin pratikartavyam, aham api tāvat pratipatsyāmi" iti

m. loc. sg., ppp. caus. ut-√pad

hindi: इस प्रकार के कलह के अवसरों पर, कलह स्वयं उत्पन्न हुआ हो या तीक्ष्णों द्वारा उत्पन्न कराया गया हो, राजा हीन पक्ष को कोश और दण्ड से सहारा देकर प्रतिकूल लोगों पर आक्रमण कराए अथवा उसे हटा ले जाए।
english: On these and similar occasions of quarrel, whether the quarrel has arisen of itself or has been produced by assassins, the king, having supported the weaker party with treasury and army, should make it attack the hostile ones, or should remove it elsewhere.
lines_deva: एवं.आदिषु कलह.स्थानेषु स्वयम् उत्पन्ने वा कलहे तीक्ष्णैर् उत्पादिते वा हीन.पक्षं राजा कोश.दण्डाभ्याम् उपगृह्य विगुणेषु विक्रमयेद् अपवाहयेद् वा
lines_iast: evaṃ.ādiṣu kalaha.sthāneṣu svayam utpanne vā kalahe tīkṣṇair utpādite vā hīna.pakṣaṃ rājā kośa.daṇḍābhyām upagṛhya viguṇeṣu vikramayed apavāhayed vā

hindi: संघों के प्रति एकराज इस प्रकार व्यवहार करे।
english: Thus should a sole king (monarch) conduct himself towards the saṅghas.
lines_deva: सङ्घेष्व् एवम् एक.राजो वर्तेत
lines_iast: saṅgheṣv evam eka.rājo varteta

words.gloss: (form as printed, unattested; sense 'overreachings, deceptions' taken from context)

hindi: और संघ भी इसी प्रकार एकराज के इन छल-प्रयोगों से अपनी रक्षा करें।
english: And the saṅghas too should in the same way guard themselves against these devices of overreaching on the part of a sole king.
notes: The line as printed does not parse: two ablative demonstratives (etebhyaḥ, ebhyaḥ) around an accusative 'atisaṅghān', a form not otherwise attested. A reading etebhyo 'tisandhānebhyo rakṣeyuḥ ('should guard themselves against these deceptions', atisandhāna as in atisandhāya of unit 40) would give regular syntax; to be checked against the printed Kangle text. Text kept as printed and translated by sense; 'themselves' is supplied.
lines_deva: सङ्घाश् च-अप्य् एवम् एक.राजाद् एतेभ्यो ऽतिसङ्घान् एभ्यो रक्षयेयुः
lines_iast: saṅghāś ca-apy evam eka.rājād etebhyo 'tisaṅghān ebhyo rakṣayeyuḥ

words.gloss: complying with the minds of all

hindi: और संघ-मुख्य संघों में न्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाला, हितकारी, प्रिय, जितेन्द्रिय, अपने लोगों से जुड़ा हुआ और सबके चित्त के अनुकूल चलने वाला होकर रहे।
english: And a chief of a saṅgha should remain among the saṅghas of just conduct, beneficial, agreeable, self-controlled, with devoted people, complying with the minds of all.
notes: Closing śloka (two 16-syllable lines). yukta-jana: 'whose people are attached (loyal)'; or 'employing fit people'.
lines_deva: सङ्घ.मुख्यश् च सङ्घेषु न्याय.वृत्तिर् हितः प्रियः
दान्तो युक्त.जनस् तिष्ठेत् सर्व.चित्त.अनुवर्तकः
lines_iast: saṅgha.mukhyaś ca saṅgheṣu nyāya.vṛttir hitaḥ priyaḥ
dānto yukta.janas tiṣṭhet sarva.citta.anuvartakaḥ
